project_type: Full-stack learning platform - Express.js backend + React frontend (Vite)
build_system: npm with separate frontend/backend packages, Vite for frontend
build_command: npm install (in backend and frontend directories)
verification_instructions: 1. Install dependencies: npm install in backend folder. 2. Start backend: npm run dev. 3. Check health endpoint: GET http://localhost:5000/api/health. 4. For frontend: npm install && npm run dev
environment_constraints: Backend requires .env file with Supabase credentials. Frontend dev server on :5173, backend on :5000
contribution_requirements: Arabic comments welcomed. Keep REST API structure compatible

key_patterns.controllers: Export async functions wrapped with asyncHandler(), use res.json() with { status, message, data }
key_patterns.middleware: auth.js exports protect, optionalAuth, restrictTo, adminOnly - verify Supabase JWT and attach user to req
key_patterns.database: All Prisma calls import prisma from ../config/database.js - replace with Supabase client
key_patterns.error_handling: AppError class for operational errors, asyncHandler wrapper for async routes
key_patterns.frontend_auth: AuthContext.jsx manages user state, stores JWT in localStorage, calls /api/auth/* endpoints
